subject: [PATCH v6 10/19] selftests/mm: add khugepaged completion barrier helper

2026-09-19.patch_summary: This patch adds a helper function called khugepaged_full_pass to the hugepage_settings module in the Linux kernel. The function is used by khugepaged tests to wait for a full pass of page scanning, which is necessary because the current implementation only polls until the scan counter has advanced by two, but this can be too short if the scan sleep time is long. The helper function uses sysfs to store the pages_to_scan value and waits for the daemon to complete one pass before returning.
